# Blackshire Motors

> Premier independent luxury and quality used car dealership located in New Castle, Delaware.

Blackshire Motors offers quality pre-owned vehicles, 0% Delaware sales tax, certified CARFAX inspection reports, flexible auto financing, and on-site certified auto repair services.

## Dealership Information
- Dealer Name: Blackshire Motors
- Location: 154 S Dupont Hwy, New Castle, DE 19720
- Phone: (302) 276-2427
- Sales Tax: 0% Delaware State Sales Tax
- Hours: Monday – Saturday: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM | Sunday: Closed
